Significance of Conversational AI
slides.narration:
Tools like ChatGPT can serve
as a reliable coding assistant.
It can help with syntax, explain
tricky concepts, review your
code, and suggest
optimizations.
It is like a knowledgeable
colleague you can ask anytime
for guidance.

Suppose I forgot how to use typedef
in C programming.
Let us go to ChatGPT and ask how to
use typedef.
First, let us create a New project.

Projects help us organize our work
better.
Projects keep chats, files, and custom
instructions in one place.

Click on Projects and enter a name
of your choice.
I will add the name, C/C++
Programming.
Click on Create Project.
Observe that the project is created.

The name of the project appears
above the Chat window.
It indicates that we are now in the
workspace of our project.
Let us now ask our queries here.

Type,
Explain how to use typedef in C
programming with some examples.
Press Enter.

ChatGPT first explains what a
typedef is, followed by its syntax and
usage.

Now, suppose I have written some
code.
I want ChatGPT to review it.

I have written a C++ code to reverse
a string.
The code works fine, but I want
ChatGPT to suggest improvements.
For that, we can directly copy and
paste the code in the Chat window.
Then give the prompt.

I have saved the file strReverse.cpp
